study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Tong et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual deviations from normative electroencephalographic connectivity predict antidepressant response

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The primary normative modeling framework developed in this study is based on a three-layer autoencoder (AE). The study also employs regression-based individual deviations using the Rutherford et al. (2022) framework (PCNtoolkit) for comparison.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The autoencoder we employed for the healthy norm development consists of three layers, including an input layer, a hidden layer, and an output layer. ... We employed this standardized framework [Rutherford et al., 2022] to derive regression-based individual deviations of rsEEG FCs.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study modeled power envelope connectivity (PEC) derived from source-space resting-state EEG (rsEEG) across four frequency bands (theta: 4–7 Hz, alpha: 8–12 Hz, beta: 13–30 Hz, and low gamma: 31–50 Hz) using a 100-ROI Schaefer atlas.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: To capture the brain functional architecture, we extracted connectomic features by calculating power envelope connectivity (PEC) (Zhang et al., 2021) since it has demonstrated strength in mitigating spurious correlations resulting from volume conduction (Hipp et al., 2012).

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.answer: Age-related: Age; Demographics: Sex; Other: None
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The autoencoder-based model is described as unsupervised and does not require pre-defined covariates. For the regression-based model comparison, age and gender (sex) were used as covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Specifically, we included age and gender as covariates (they were the only two demographic variables shared by all three independent cohorts) and calculated individual deviations in FCs with reference to the age and gender-based FC prediction ... autoencoder-based normative modeling is unsupervised, thus not requiring pre-defined covariates
